what_happened: The operator wrote the fix request for the D43 rejection (job 20261024-045548-7qht). It let a recorded passing check count as having been run. Neither the request nor the verifier prompt said the verifier must list that command in the criterion's structured commands field. Job 20261024-033935-c4w4's verifier cited the recorded results only in its evidence text and left commands empty. The D43 rule reads the commands field, so the job was rejected again. The job field is empty, so this is an intervention note, not a failed job record.
cause: Athena has no cross-check between an agent instruction and the rule that judges that agent's output. Here the rule reads a structured field, and the instruction never named that field. The author of a prompt change is not shown the exact fields the judging code reads, and nothing compares the two before dispatch. A mismatch only shows up when a verifier rejects a job. The first fix repeated the gap of the original request, so the same class recurred.
prevention: Add a check that runs when a request or job changes verifier or agent instructions. It lists the output fields the judging rules in verify.rs read, such as the commands field in D43, and requires the changed prompt text to name each of those fields. The same check should be shown to the reader and critic so they can reject an instruction that describes evidence without naming the field. Add a test that a verifier output with evidence text but empty commands is rejected, and that the prompt tells the verifier to fill commands. Together these would have prevented both this miss and the earlier one.
proposed_request: Make the verifier prompt and the D43 rule in verify.rs agree on how a recorded passing check counts as run. Outcome: when a verifier relies on one of Athena's recorded passing checks for a behavior criterion, the prompt tells it to list that exact command in the criterion's commands field, and D43 accepts the criterion as met when that listed command matches a recorded passing check. Evidence text alone with commands empty must still be unmet. Acceptance: (1) a test where the verifier output cites a recorded passing check in the commands field and D43 treats the criterion as met; (2) a test where the same citation appears only in the evidence text with commands empty and D43 treats it as unmet; (3) the verifier prompt names the commands field explicitly, and the prompt token budgets test still passes. Also add a check that fails when any field read by a verdict rule in verify.rs is not named in the verifier prompt, so this mismatch is caught before dispatch. Then re-run job 20261024-033935-c4w4's criteria as the demonstration.
